{{Quote|Look, you can kill a woolly-nerf and make a coat out of its skin, or you can shear the beast's coat and come back year after year for more wool.|[[Corran Horn/Legends|Corran Horn]]|<ref name="I, Jedi">''[[I, Jedi]]''</ref>}}
'''Wooly-nerfs''' were a [[Subspecies/Legends|subspecies]] of the [[Nerf/Legends|nerf]].

When [[Corran Horn/Legends|Corran Horn]] was infiltrating with the [[Khuiumin Survivors]] (using the alias [[Jenos Idanian]]), he tried to convince the pirates to use non-lethal tactics for raiding ships and colonies, citing as an example the greater gains from fleecing a wooly nerf as opposed to skinning it.
